load_onnx_model: load an ONNX model from a local path using CPUExecutionProvider or a custom provider
run_onnx_inference: run inference on an OnnxRuntimeModel by passing input tensors as keyword arguments
save_onnx_pretrained: save an OnnxRuntimeModel to a directory including external weights for large models
load_onnx_from_hub: load an ONNX model from the HuggingFace Hub or a local directory using from_pretrained
map_ort_to_numpy: map ONNX Runtime tensor type strings to their corresponding NumPy dtype equivalents
